info.title: Ainur POS Connect API
info.description:
Our API Connect structure is modeled after Shopify API to reduce entry barrier for integrators. NOTE this different terminology mapping: Ainur Groups (one per product) are mapped to “ext-category” similar to product categories/collections in Shopify. Also Ainur categories (many per product) are better known as Tags and are therefore mapped to “ext-tags” variable, matching Shopify naming.

**Required fields:** In request bodies, query parameters, and headers, any field marked as required in the schema (and shown with an asterisk * next to the name in Swagger UI) must be provided.

get.description: Returns company information for the authenticated token. Required fields are marked with an asterisk (*) in the documented schema.

plan.description: Current subscription plan of the company

email.description: Primary email address of the company

timezone.description: Timezone offset in seconds from UTC

daily_email_report.description: Whether daily email reports are enabled

ecom_invite_accepted.description: Whether the e-commerce invite has been accepted

currentUser.description: Information about the currently authenticated user

type.description: User role within the company (e.g. owner, staff)

invited.description: Unix timestamp when the user was invited

stopped.description: Unix timestamp when the user was deactivated (null if active)

stores.description: List of store IDs the user has access to

get.description: Returns a paginated list of inventory change (stock adjustment) documents for the company from the access token. If time_start and time_end are omitted, the last 7 days are used. When both dates are provided, the period must not exceed 31 days. Required fields are marked with an asterisk (*) in the documented schema.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Pagination: number of records to return (1–100)

parameters.name: time_start
parameters.description: Period start (Y-m-d H:i:s). Required when time_end is set; must be before time_end

parameters.name: time_end
parameters.description: Period end (Y-m-d H:i:s). Required when time_start is set; must be after time_start

parameters.name: users[]
parameters.description: Filter by user IDs who created documents

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Filter documents containing the given product

parameters.name: search_text
parameters.description: Text search in document number and comment

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Search by document number (exact or regex)

parameters.name: access_stores[]
parameters.description: Restrict results to allowed store IDs

200.description: List of change documents retrieved successfully

actor.description: User who performed the action (id, name, email, phone)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of sales and return_sales documents. Pass include_inventory_movements=true to attach per-product inventory movements (qty, stock, cost) merged by document id; without it, only document headers are returned. When include_inventory_movements is true, filters are aligned: time_start/time_end (period), from or access_stores[0] (store), product_id, users/user (creator). If time_start and time_end are omitted, the last 7 days are used. When both dates are provided, the period must not exceed 31 days.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination: number of records to skip

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Pagination: number of records to return (1–100)

parameters.name: time_start
parameters.description: Period start (Y-m-d H:i:s). Required when time_end is set; must be before time_end

parameters.name: time_end
parameters.description: Period end (Y-m-d H:i:s). Required when time_start is set; must be after time_start

parameters.name: users[]
parameters.description: Filter by user IDs who created documents

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Filter documents containing the given product

parameters.name: search_text
parameters.description: Text search in document number and comment

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Search by document number (exact or regex)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Source store ID (for sales — warehouse/store). Used as store filter for inventory movements when include_inventory_movements=true

parameters.name: access_stores[]
parameters.description: Restrict results to allowed store IDs. First value is used as store filter when from is omitted (only when include_inventory_movements=true)

parameters.name: include_inventory_movements
parameters.description: When true, fetches product-level inventory movements and attaches them as inventory_movements on each document. Omitted or false returns documents only.

200.description: List of sales documents; inventory_movements is present only when include_inventory_movements=true

line_items.description: Document line items from the POS register. Legacy fields inside legacy_line (including cost) may be absent depending on the cashier role permissions at the time of sale — e.g. cost is omitted when the user has no catalog.fields.cost access. For reliable unit cost and stock data, request include_inventory_movements=true and use inventory_movements[].cost.

legacy_line.description: Raw POS line payload. May include cost and other register fields; not guaranteed — depends on cashier permissions and POS configuration.

actor.description: User who performed the action (id, name, email, phone)

inventory_movements.description: Present only when include_inventory_movements=true. Product-level inventory movements for this document, joined by document id. Preferred source for unit cost and stock balances. Nested doc object is omitted as duplicate of the parent document.

price.description: Sale price per unit from the register

cost.description: Unit cost from inventory movements. Authoritative cost field when include_inventory_movements=true; omitted if the API token role lacks catalog.fields.cost permission.

stock.description: Stock levels per store after the movement {storeId: qty}

403.description: Forbidden - no permission or feature not available for the company

get.description: Get product by token. Required fields are marked with an asterisk (*) in the documented schema. The product catalog for this endpoint is reconciled with the remote source at most once every 3 minutes per company (per-route refresh window).

store_prices.description: Per-store unit prices keyed by store ID. Returned only when per-store prices are enabled in the product settings; otherwise the field is null or omitted and `price` is the catalog price.

in_stock.description: Whether the product is available in at least one store

tags.description: Ainur category list (categories[]) mapped to ext-tags and synced as tags in WooCommerce and Shopify

components.description: Components included in the product (for bundles/sets)

exist.description: Whether the component exists in the system

parameters.name: updated_start

parameters.description: End of updated date range (format: Y-m-d H:i:s). Must be after or equal to updated_start.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: The ID of the store (24-character hexadecimal string) for which the stock should be checked.

parameters.name: ext-tag
parameters.description: Optional filter: restrict results to products that have this Ainur category label as an ext-tag. Use the same human-readable names as returned by GET /product/ext-tags (e.g. Five, Woo). In responses this maps to the product `tags` array (synced to tags in WooCommerce and Shopify). Omit this parameter to list products without filtering by tag. Maximum length 255 characters.

parameters.name: min_stock
parameters.description: Minimum stock value. Can only be provided together with store_id. Must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.

parameters.name: max_stock
parameters.description: Maximum stock value. Can only be provided together with store_id. Must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.
